lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere sevak kau bhau kichh naahee jam nahee aavai nere ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your servant is not afraid of anything; the Messenger of Death cannot even approach him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo terai ra(n)g raate suaamee tinh kaa janam maran dukh naasaa ||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to Your Love, O my Lord and Master, are released from the pains of birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਬਖਸ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: teree bakhas na metai koee satigur kaa dilaasaa ||2||
lines.translation: No one can erase Your Blessings; the True Guru has given me this assurance. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaain sukh phal paain aath pahar aaraadhahi ||
lines.translation: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, obtain the fruits of peace. Twenty-four hours a day, they worship and adore You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਭਰਵਾਸੈ ਪੰਚ ਦੁਸਟ ਲੈ ਸਾਧਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: teree saran terai bharavaasai pa(n)ch dusat lai saadhahi ||3||
lines.translation: In Your Sanctuary, with Your Support, they subdue the five villains. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan dhiaan kichh karam na jaanaa saar na jaanaa teree ||
lines.translation: I know nothing about wisdom, meditation and good deeds; I know nothing about Your excellence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਵਡਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: sabh te vadaa satigur naanak jin kal raakhee meree ||4||10||57||
lines.translation: Guru Nanak is the greatest of all; He saved my honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||4||10||57||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: soohee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Soohee, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal tiaag gur saranee aaiaa raakhahu raakhanahaare ||
lines.translation: Renouncing everything, I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary; save me, O my Savior Lord!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਹਮ ਲਾਗਹ ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jit too laavahi tit ham laagah kiaa ehi ja(n)t vichaare ||1||
lines.translation: Whatever You link me to, to that I am linked; what can this poor creature do? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਜੀ ਤੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere raam jee too(n) prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||
lines.translation: O my Dear Lord God, You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa guradev daiaalaa gun gaavaa nit suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Be Merciful to me, O Divine, Compassionate Guru, that I may constantly sing the Glorious Praises of my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਭਉ ਤਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar prabh apanaa dhiaaeeai gur prasaad bhau tareeai ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on my God; by Guru's Grace, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਹੋਈਐ ਸਭ ਰੇਣਾ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਇਉ ਮਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aap tiaag hoeeai sabh renaa jeevatiaa iu mareeai ||2||
lines.translation: Renouncing self-conceit, I have become the dust of all men's feet; in this way, I die, while I am still alive. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਉ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal janam tis kaa jag bheetar saadhasa(n)g naau jaape ||
lines.translation: How fruitful is the life of that being in this world, who chants the Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath tis ke pooran jis daiaa kare prabh aape ||3||
lines.translation: All desires are fulfilled, for the one who is blessed with God's Kindness and Mercy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal kripaal prabh suaamee teree saran daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: O Merciful to the meek, Kind and Compassionate Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੫੮॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa apanaa naam deejai naanak saadh ravaalaa ||4||11||58||
lines.translation: Take pity upon me, and bless me with Your Name. Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||11||58||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee asatapadeeaa mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, Ashtapadee, First Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਮੈ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh avagan mai gun nahee koee ||
lines.translation: I am totally without virtue; I have no virtue at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kiu kar ka(n)t milaavaa hoee ||1||
lines.translation: How can I meet my Husband Lord? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਮੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਬੰਕੇ ਨੈਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa mai roop na ba(n)ke nainaa ||
lines.translation: I have no beauty, no enticing eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੁਲ ਢੰਗੁ ਨ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa kul dha(n)g na meethe bainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I do not have a noble family, good manners or a sweet voice. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj seegaar kaaman kar aavai ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride adorns herself with peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾ ਕੰਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa sohaagan jaa ka(n)tai bhaavai ||2||
lines.translation: But she is a happy soul-bride, only if her Husband Lord is pleased with her. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖਿਆ ਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa tis roop na rekhiaa kaaee ||
lines.translation: He has no form or feature;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t na saahib simariaa jaaee ||3||
lines.translation: at the very last instant, he cannot suddenly be contemplated. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat mat naahee chaturaaee ||
lines.translation: I have no understanding, intellect or cleverness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh laavahu paaee ||4||
lines.translation: Have Mercy upon me, God, and attach me to Your Feet. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਰੀ ਸਿਆਣੀ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kharee siaanee ka(n)t na bhaanee ||
lines.translation: She may be very clever, but this does not please her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa laagee bharam bhulaanee ||5||
lines.translation: Attached to Maya, she is deluded by doubt. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਈ ਤਾ ਕੰਤ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai jaaee taa ka(n)t samaaee ||
lines.translation: But if she gets rid of her ego, then she merges in her Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਉ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: tau kaaman piaare nav nidh paaee ||6||
lines.translation: Only then can the soul-bride obtain the nine treasures of her Beloved. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik janam bichhurat dukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Separated from You for countless incarnations, I have suffered in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi lehu preetam prabh raaiaa ||7||
lines.translation: Please take my hand, O my Beloved Sovereign Lord God. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹੁ ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak sahu hai bhee hosee ||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, the Lord is, and shall always be.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਤੈ ਰਾਵੇਸੀ ॥੮॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jai bhaavai piaaraa tai raavesee ||8||1||
lines.translation: She alone is ravished and enjoyed, with whom the Beloved Lord is pleased. ||8||1||
